/ai-form-builder/job-application-form.note: craft: Eight sentences end on a tacked-on ', so [benefit]' clause (defect 4 pattern): features_subheading ', so applicants can be compared line by line'; feature_3 ', so a reviewer opens one record, not an inbox'; feature_6 ', so engineering can take over the hiring flow without a rebuild'; howto_step_5 ', so the applicant table doubles as your hiring pipeline'; howto_step_6 ', so every answer lands in one place'; FAQ 8 ', so paper and online applicants are compared on equal terms'; FAQ 10 ', so it collects only what the employer needs to decide'; FAQ 13 ', so the reviewer opens it next to the answers'. Hero also trails ', with no cap on how many people apply'. Fix: end each sentence on its point and cut or give the benefit its own sentence only where it adds something; keep at most one ', so' on the page. | voice: Tidy triplets set the rhythm: all four tabs open on the same 'X, Y, and Z' shape ('choose a store, mark the shifts..., and give a start date'; 'license number, issuing state, and expiry date'; 'employee ID, current team, and months in role' plus 'checks tenure..., alerts their current manager, and keeps...'; 'upload a resume and portfolio, confirm work authorization, and give a salary range'), and howto_step_7 adds another ('the right questions appear, the files attach, and the alert reaches the right person'). The nurse/delivery/designer triplet appears twice (feature_2 and howto_step_3). 'six standard sections' is repeated six times (howto_description, howto_step_2, FAQ 5, 8, 9, plus feature_1's 'six standard sections' H3). 'one record, not an inbox' is a stock contrast. Fix: break the tab openings into different shapes, keep the role examples in one place, and say 'six standard sections' once or twice. | truth: FAQ 8 says the form Emergent builds 'prints as a one-page PDF with the six standard sections', but FAQ 9 says fitting a single page means trimming it ('one past job instead of three, one reference') and asking for 'the one-page version', so the two answers contradict each other; the 'three' past jobs default appears nowhere else (howto_step_2 says work history repeats 'for every past job'). The meta 'saves a PDF of every submission to a database you own' overstates feature_4 ('Every submission can produce a PDF'), and FAQ 4 'Emergent can print a blank job application form PDF' credits Emergent with printing. Claims ids all approved under the capability principle; cycle-1 section-list and government-name issues are fixed. Fix: one consistent story on PDF length, drop 'instead of three', align meta and FAQ 4 with feature_4. | faq: Several answers restate body copy instead of adding to it: FAQ 13 'from a phone or computer, with no account to create. Each file is saved with its application record' repeats feature_3 and howto_step_4 nearly word for word; FAQ 14 'lands in your database as a new row, and the hiring manager gets a Slack or email alert' repeats feature_5; FAQ 4 'for walk-in applicants ... the personnel file' repeats feature_4 and howto_step_6; FAQ 1 repeats features_subheading ('same questions ... compare'); FAQ 12 repeats feature_2. Secondaries bend sentences: FAQ 4 'produce an employment application form PDF of every online submission', FAQ 15 'Any application forms that combine questions, uploads, and a review step', FAQ 11 'How does a hiring application form sort applicants?' is not how people ask. FAQ 10 'What is ... used for?' answers when it is filled in, not what it is used for. Fix: give each FAQ answer something the body does not say (file types and size, what happens to rejected applicants, how long to keep applications), and place secondaries where they read as speech.
